cycleSardiniaEs.name: Difficulty
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our e-bike tours are specially designed for recreational cyclists who enjoy discovering the region at a relaxed pace. These tours focus on enjoying the landscape, cultural heritage, and history of the area. Thanks to electric assistance, these routes are accessible to almost everyone with a basic  level of fitness. However, it's important to note that we divide the tours into three difficulty levels, based on distance and elevation gain. While the e-bike takes much of the physical effort out of cycling, longer distances or greater elevation can still make for a more challenging ride.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: To participate in these cycling holidays, it’s important that you have a good basic fitness level, cycle regularly, and are comfortable shifting gears efficiently when climbing, this will greatly enhance your enjoyment on the road.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: See Blog for more information “Cycle Grades Tour E-Bike”

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Group size
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tours are designed for small groups to ensure a safe, enjoyable, and high-quality experience. A minimum of 6 participants is required to organize the tour. The maximum number of participants is 14, which allows us to provide attentive service, maintain safety on the road, and ensure a personalized experience throughout the tour.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Tailor-made version
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: For private groups, our tours can be fully tailored to your needs and preferences. Whether you want to adjust the itinerary, choose specific accommodations, or select the tour dates, we can create a personalized experience just for your group. To get started, we will send you a simple form to fill out with your preferences and requirements. Once we receive it, we will work with you to design a tour that perfectly matches your group’s interests, pace, and style.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Self-Guided Tours
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Our tour can also be organized as a self-guided experience, allowing you to explore Andalusia at your own pace. In this case, we will provide you with all the necessary information, including detailed route notes, accommodation details, and any additional guidance to ensure a smooth trip

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Accommodations
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: This is a Point-to-Point Tour, which means you will cycle from one destination to the next each day, staying in a different hotel along the route. Your luggage will be transferred between accommodations, allowing you to enjoy each day's ride without carrying your bags. This style of tour lets you experience a greater variety of landscapes, villages, and local culture while progressing through the region, with each day ending at a new hotel ready for your arrival.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: The hotels included in our tours have been carefully selected with great attention to their location, comfort, and quality, to ensure a pleasant and relaxing stay throughout your cycling holiday. In each destination, we work with more than one carefully chosen hotel. This allows us to guarantee a consistently high standard of accommodation and to remain flexible. The final hotel allocation is determined according to the number of participants and availability at the time of booking, while always maintaining the same level of comfort and service. All accommodations used on our tours are rated between 3 and 4 stars, offering a good balance of quality and comfort. The accommodations include breakfast and provide attentive service, often with facilities such as a restaurant, bar, garden, and swimming pool. The hotel rooms are private standard single or double rooms, depending on the hotel, and each comes with a private bathroom. If you wish to share a room with a friend, family member, or partner, please indicate this when making your pre-reservation so we can prepare the appropriate rooming list.
cycleSardiniaEs.text7: • We do not pair single travelers with other participants they do not know, in order to respect privacy and ensure comfort.
cycleSardiniaEs.text8: • Adding extra days at our selected accommodations can be arranged, but must be requested in advance.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Transport
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: On this tour, we provide private transportation to ensure smooth transfers and maximum flexibility. Montaraz uses its own 8-seat passenger vehicle and, when required for groups larger than seven participants, works with a trusted private transport company. Transportation is provided to take guests to the starting point of each itinerary and to collect them at the end of the ride.
cycleSardiniaEs.text2: The Montaraz 8-seat passenger car also serves as a support vehicle for safety and comfort. It is available if someone needs a rest, experiences fatigue, or requires assistance along the route.
cycleSardiniaEs.text3: We also arrange airport transfers at the beginning and end of the tour, allowing you to travel comfortably and enjoy the experience without logistical concerns.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Flight Information
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: At the start of the tour, participants arrive either at the airport or train station in Málaga , where a private transfer will be waiting to take them to their hotel

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Optional Activities
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Some extra experiences need to be booked in advance, while others can be decided on the day, depending on how you feel. For more information about these activities, visit our blog: Cycle Tour Ronda-Córdoba

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Dietary Requirements
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: There are no problems accommodating vegetarian or vegan diets on this tour. Please let us know in advance if you have specific dietary requirements, so that our accommodations and restaurants can prepare accordingly.

cycleSardiniaEs.name: Weather in Andalusia
cycleSardiniaEs.text1: Spring and autumn are the ideal seasons to explore Andalusia by bicycle. During these months, temperatures are comfortable, the landscapes are at their most colourful, and the weather is generally stable, making for enjoyable days on the bike. Spring is one of the best times to cycle in Andalusia. Days are typically sunny and mild, with daytime temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C (59°F–77°F). March can still bring some cool mornings and occasional showers, while April and May are usually warm, green, and full of wildflowers.  Autumn offers equally excellent cycling conditions. September remains warm, with temperatures often reaching 25°C to 30°C (77°F–86°F) during the day, while October and November bring more moderate temperatures between 15°C and 25°C (59°F–77°F).  As in spring, mornings can be cool, especially in October and November, making layered clothing the best option for comfort throughout the day.
